s.en: My heart is healthy.
The doctor listened to my heart yesterday.
s.ko: 의사 선생님이 어제 제 심장 소리를 들으셨어요.

s.en: Walking will make your heart strong.
s.ko: 걷기는 당신의 심장을 튼튼하게 해 줄 거예요.

s.en: Reading is good for the brain.
The doctor checked my brain last month.
s.ko: 의사 선생님이 지난달에 제 뇌를 검사하셨어요.

s.en: Good sleep will help your brain.
s.ko: 좋은 잠은 당신의 뇌에 도움이 될 거예요.

s.en: The nurse checks my blood every year.
I gave blood at the hospital last spring.
They will check my blood tomorrow morning.
s.ko: 내일 아침에 제 피를 검사할 거예요.

s.en: Milk is good for your bones.
I broke a bone in my arm last year.
The doctor will look at the bone.
s.ko: 의사 선생님이 그 뼈를 살펴보실 거예요.

s.en: My skin is dry in winter.
My skin was red after a day in the sun.
s.ko: 햇볕 아래에서 하루를 보낸 뒤 제 피부가 빨갰어요.

s.en: This soap will be gentle on your skin.
s.ko: 이 비누는 당신의 피부에 순할 거예요.

s.en: My stomach hurts after a big meal.
I had a pain in my stomach last night.
This medicine will help your stomach.
s.ko: 이 약은 당신의 위에 도움이 될 거예요.

s.en: My back tooth hurts when I drink cold water.
The doctor pulled my bad tooth last month.
s.ko: 지난달에 의사가 제 나쁜 이를 뽑았어요.

s.en: My daughter is going to lose a tooth soon.
I wash my back with warm water.
My back felt better after a long rest yesterday.
s.ko: 어제 오래 쉬고 나니 허리가 나아졌어요.

s.en: I will stretch my back every morning.
s.ko: 저는 매일 아침 허리를 쭉 펼 거예요.

s.en: My neck hurts from using the computer.
I had a pain in my neck last week.
I will keep my neck warm in winter.
s.ko: 저는 겨울에 목을 따뜻하게 할 거예요.

s.en: My shoulders hurt after I do the laundry.
The nurse touched my shoulder yesterday.
I will move my shoulders up and down.
